component.name: Groovy
component.summary: Share files and messages directly with the people you trust

description.p: Groovy sends files, shares folders and carries messages straight between your devices and the people you pair with. There is no account and no server holding your data: devices connect directly, or through a relay when they cannot.

ul.li: Send files and folders of any size, with resume
Keep shared folders in step between members
Direct and group messages, delivered when contacts come back online
Link your devices so contacts trust all of them
